scope: Canonical WorkerClient sequential-owner cancellation and lifecycle observation only, after correcting supervisor diagnostic observation timestamps.

sourceRaw.digest_scope: Original private raw bytes, before public redaction; not a digest of this JSON embedding.

model.provenance: Existing read-only E4B model; no download or model copy. No-offer header measures SHA-256; cancellation raw records path/size/mtime, with same-model identity supplied by parent handoff, not a cancellation-native hash measurement.

outcome.exit_code_source: Completed parent execution handoff; not a raw child wait status.

configuration_scope.selection: One fixed attempt for each probe per session, same sequential WorkerClient/model owner; no retry selection. Worker seeds and worker build versions remain null as observed. Exact inputs and configs appear in raw_report.worker_sessions[].cancellation.

observation_clock_correction.defect: Supervisor step-entry operational time was reused for ready/result/done observations and retirement after lock waits.
observation_clock_correction.change: Diagnostic timestamps now record actual observation/retention after waits. Operational grace/idle policy, request accounting and ownership were not changed.

parent_macos_source_gate.counts_scope: Parent full-gate reported pass totals, including its subprocess test summaries; not asserted as unique tests.
parent_macos_source_gate.evidence: Existing parent-executed macOS source-gate log; regression lines directly inspected, no checks rerun by receipt author.

interpretation: Pass means the recorded supervisor trigger/revocation, matching nonfailed terminal report, terminal accounting, quiescence, consumer silence, and separately acknowledged release/shutdown contract passed.

After-result probes each observed a real nonempty nonfinal IPC result (" prepare") while the matching request was active. This is not evidence that the native producer or kernel was still executing at cancellation.

TerminalReport.cancelled and metrics.cancelled combine supervisor/worker cancellation. They do not provide native cancellation acknowledgement; both native acknowledgement/interruption fields stay null.
Consumer poll suppression of revoked output is not producer stopping proof. A native completion racing after the observation is unobservable.

Matching terminal timestamps, native work, before/after counters, zero lost/unreported deltas, cleanup and close observations are retained in the raw report. These are not GPU reclamation, raw child exit, physical editing or latency/SLA claims.

sourceRaw.capture: SHA-256 of original raw bytes; private location and runtime identities omitted.

historical_observations.interpretation: Original cap-24 short-prompt v1 AFTER-result probes were inconclusive_request_already_completed in all three sessions. This failure/inconclusive receipt remains unchanged; later workload and clock changes do not retroactively make it pass.

sourceRaw.digest_scope: Original private raw bytes, before public redaction; not a digest of this JSON embedding.

historical_observations.interpretation: Earlier v2 pre-observation-clock-fix run retained privately. Latest corrected-clock report is the current evidence; old timestamps are not silently rewritten.

semantic_criteria: Preserve the decomposed combining characters and complete a real word such as manutenção.

comparison.model_owner: fresh process/model per round; retained across cases
comparison.seed_derivation: SHA-256(brotypist-paired-case-round-v2\0 || root-u32-LE || round-index-u64-LE || case-ID-UTF8), first-u32-LE modulo 4294967295; MAX maps to zero, all other words unchanged

candidate_acceptance: No loss of nonempty availability on these required-offer cases; all-empty output is failure.
No new unrelated-topic, uncertainty or suffix-join failures relative to baseline.
Show an observed useful improvement on at least one focused-context failure across controlled cold and warm rounds; a safer-sounding prompt alone is not semantic acceptance.
Do not substitute new weights, strengthened custom preferences, exact-output matches, extra abstention filters, relaxed limits or private context to make a candidate pass.
matching_conditions: Use the same cached selected Gemma4 E2B Q4_0 weights, native backend, token/word caps, acceleration and authored cases for baseline and candidate.
Keep cold fresh-worker rounds separate from warm within-worker sequences; alternate case order across repetitions. Do not call a fresh worker an OS/Metal cache flush.
Record exact insertion and assembled prefix + insertion + suffix, nonempty availability and per-dimension reviewer labels/reasons.
Compare both positive contextual utility and negative unrelated-reference/uncertainty/suffix boundaries. No global quality claim from this small corpus.

raw_report.implementation: Rust native diagnostics and canonical WorkerClient

methodology.alternatives: Canonical alternatives algorithm: zero to three distinct strict insertable caret continuations, excluding anchor. Empty output or [] is safe absence only if mechanical checks pass; actual counts/empty results remain separately reported. Availability is not semantic quality.
methodology.cancellation: Direct preserves pre-cancel and synchronous cancellation before display at the first real native UTF-8 callback, observing real sampler return/cleanup. Worker separately probes before proceed and after first observed IPC result with bounded quiescence; already completed producer is inconclusive, not fabricated as active native interruption.
methodology.displayable: First nonblank cumulative canonical insertion, or first parse_choices-compatible utility array, measured in that path's consumer. Worker time_to_first_worker_result_ms can include empty final output; neither is necessarily raw native first-token latency.
methodology.fairness: Same cases, length and diagnostic token caps; per-round rotated case order; model order alternates. Direct-only opt-in paired-case seeds derive from root seed, case ID and round, independent of model/prompt/order; subsequent alternative samplers retain native recurrence. Optional cold-KV clears actual KV/logits per case, not model owner or OS cache. Ordinary mode preserves production sampling. Worker is never a controlled seed pair. Descriptive samples only; no quality guarantee or SLA. Subsets identify incomplete corpus coverage.
methodology.isolation: Explicit fresh empty INKLOW_HOME, mode-0700 root and exclusive mode-0600 report. Direct diagnostics use a fresh owned self-child and fresh HOME/XDG/INKLOW_HOME per model/round. Worker mode uses a fresh canonical WorkerClient owner and explicit native --app. Only in-memory validated Config; no app settings, Runtime, desktop capture, history, clipboard, screenshots, credentials, downloads or external inference.
methodology.memory: Direct self-child Darwin getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss in bytes: process-lifetime high-water RSS, including Rust/native/shared mappings. Per-case values are cumulative, not incremental or GPU/Metal/whole-machine memory. Measured in the same direct sessions as inference. Worker-only RSS is null because the explicit native child does not expose its own rusage over WorkerClient; never substitute parent/all-children RSS. No cross-path memory comparison.
methodology.reference_budget: Direct retains the complete oversized authored context and canonical tokenizer-based budget clipping. Authored reference_sources use canonical reference_context's 8000-byte budget. Only worker transport bounds oversized direct context to 8000 scalars and identifies truncation. No fake reference sources.
methodology.sampler: Direct calls observe actual NativeModel prompt token counts/BOS occurrences, selected production SamplerOptions, native allowance, grammar/stops, raw UTF-8 before canonical replay/display filtering, finish reasons and sampler-return cleanup. NativeModel's byte-level stop fence precedes UTF-8 callbacks, as native stop handling precedes old Python chunks. No instrumentation changes production sampling. Current public ABI does not expose resolved batch/thread/mmap/mlock getters; those are null with reasons, not guessed defaults.
methodology.seed_observation: Raw native recurrence state is separate from the actual sampler seed. Actual seed stays null when no sampler is observed or the ordinary recurrence selects the native random sentinel; paired v2 first seeds cannot select that sentinel. Alternatives retain the ordinary recurrence.
methodology.timing: Direct: Instant around actual NativeModel open plus canonical warmup, and around direct stream to native return plus canonical filtering. Includes tokenization, native inference and display filtering, excludes parent process startup/IPC. Worker: prepare submission through prepared+done includes child startup/IPC/polling; stream clocks begin immediately before explicit proceed and end on final+done. Includes IPC and 2ms consumer polling, excludes desktop/debounce/rendering. Fresh process is not cleared OS/filesystem/Metal caches. Failed/partial requests are not completed latency samples. Direct and worker summaries are separate; never pooled or paired across paths. No physical typing/key-to-screen claim.

not_tested: Calibrated semantic quality, grammar, factuality or language grading
Total GPU memory or latency SLA
raw_report.review_policy: No automatic grammar, language or overall quality score. Record exact outputs and reviewer identity/kind (human or assistant), per-dimension labels and reasons. Assistant review is not human validation; neither is calibrated without independent agreement measurements. Mechanical success and supported literals never imply semantic acceptance. Empty alternatives are availability loss, not successful grammar.

semantic_rubric.contextual_utility: Nonempty continuation advances the writer's current situation with an appropriate supported next action, useful detail, or explicit uncertainty. Empty output and generic questions that do not advance the situation are availability/utility failures, never quality wins. Do not require an exact phrase or demand every reference fact be repeated.
semantic_rubric.grammar: Read prefix + insertion + suffix as one draft. Agreement, case, conjugation and idiom must fit. A short, deliberately unfinished phrase at the configured word cap is not a grammar failure merely because it lacks a full stop; malformed words or an impossible join are failures.
semantic_rubric.grounding: Every specific fact used must agree with the supplied synthetic reference and draft. Do not invent missing times, rooms or dates. Literal checks only detect declared exact contradictions/support; they do not validate all factual claims. A negated alternative such as 'Room Cedar, not Room Maple' is not a contradiction.
semantic_rubric.language: Continue in the current draft's language, including Portuguese accents and regional preferences when supplied. Reference language and quoted foreign text must not cause translation or a language switch.
semantic_rubric.lexical_join: Inspect the exact caret boundary and assembled word. No space inside a started word, prefix replay, duplicated trailing space, invented word fragment or broken combining character. A mechanically printable feedeme is unacceptable.
semantic_rubric.suffix_join: Read through the untouched suffix. Do not repeat it, add a full stop before a continuing phrase, or break punctuation/agreement. A shorter insertion can be acceptable if the resulting sentence is coherent.

unsupported_measurements: Resolved native batch/thread/mmap/mlock getters absent from current public ABI
Worker-only per-child peak RSS absent from its protocol
Incremental allocations and total GPU/Metal memory
